materials_exhausted.note: Reopened handoff packet, packet/raw XML, PDF text, OA package members, local supplementary Image_1 PDF/text and landing-bin inventory, locator index, linked database JSONL, and relevant merged database snapshots. Packet material status remains material_extracted_with_gaps, but no worker-4/6 gate-changing local source gap remains after bounded review.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet is kept separate: XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database locators exist, extraction status is material_extracted_with_gaps, and the remaining gaps did not block worker-4/6 source adjudication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Final JSON artifacts satisfy the structural contract only after source-reviewed final rewrites; validator readiness is not treated as publication-grade by itself.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP linked rows were rechecked against primary XML tables/sections and linked database snapshots. Exact source/database name disagreements are preserved as source_conflict cautions with row locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence now uses primary Tables 1-2 plus bactericidal and hemolysis result sections; comparative Table 3 parser artifacts were removed from the final activity layer.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to armadillidin H assays that directly tested killing, membrane permeabilization, microscopy, hemolysis, CD, and NMR; no molecular target is overclaimed and Q is not assigned H-only mechanism evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The prior full_source_review_not_completed and database_conflicts_require_adjudication blockers are closed. Remaining issues are caution-level source/database nomenclature conflicts, not blocking/major open rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Several database target names use non-source-local taxonomy, spelling, or strain formatting (for example Micrococcus luteus vs primary Micrococcus lysodeikticus, Mammaliicoccus lentus vs primary Staphylococcus lentus, Empedobacter brevis vs primary Flavobacterium breve, Enterobacter D03 vs primary DO3, Klebsiella vs primary Klebiella, and B05-10 vs primary B05.10). These rows remain source_conflict cautions rather than unresolved rework.
Armadillidin Q has primary activity-table support, but downstream bactericidal, membrane-permeabilization, microscopy, hemolysis, CD, and NMR experiments were performed only with armadillidin H.
Primary Table 3 is a comparative glycine-rich AMP context table; prior parser-derived pI/glycine-content rows were removed from final activity evidence.

Local supplementary material is the CD/NMR-related Image_1 PDF/text plus publisher landing HTML assets; no local supplementary spreadsheet/activity table changes the source-reviewed activity/database/mechanism adjudication.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 for armadillidin H/Q. Primary XML tables, PDF text, local supplementary Image_1 material, OA package members, and linked database rows were reopened; final database, activity/toxicity, mechanism, and review artifacts now preserve source-supported values and retain only caution-level database/source nomenclature conflicts.
